summary:
Iteration 4 (frontend-only) verified end-to-end. (1) TROPHY CABINET: testID trophy-cabinet shows 4 small trophies (trophy-2022..2025) each containing year + only emoji (🌍 for 2022/2023/2025, 🇳🇿 for 2024) — the 'Team World'/'Team NZ' text is gone. Inner text verified: '2022
🌍', '2023
🌍', '2024
🇳🇿', '2025
🌍'. (2) BIG TROPHY 2026: no longer shows 'Decided after the final round'. When leaderboard.cup_winner is null it shows '?'; when set, shows the winner label (e.g. '🌍 Team World'). Verified both states — observed '?' with current no-winner state and '🌍 Team World' earlier when a winner was set. (3) PHOTO CROPPER: tapping btn-upload-photo on Bio tab opens native file picker (web file chooser), after choosing a non-square 800x500 JPEG the custom crop screen appears with testID cropper-frame. All 4 controls work: cropper-zoom-in, cropper-zoom-out, cropper-reset, cropper-cancel, cropper-done. Cancel closes modal with no upload. Done pipes through expo-image-manipulator to a 512x512 JPEG and POSTs to /api/photos-self — avatar on Bio and Players tabs updates and GET /api/players returns photo_path for the player (confirmed photo_path = 'the-swifty-cup-2026/players/{id}/{hash}.jpg'). Drag on frame via mouse down/move/up also works. (4) ADMIN ALL BIOS: 3-dot menu (testID header-menu-button) → Admin Login (menu-admin-login) → PIN 1926 via admin-pin-input/admin-pin-submit → menu now exposes menu-admin-bios and menu-logout → navigates to bios-screen with testID bio-row-{id} rows. Tapping a row opens the edit sheet with btn-upload-photo which also opens the SAME cropper and uploads via /api/photos — verified photo_path saved for Wade Mackie. (5) REGRESSION: all 5 tabs (Rounds, Board, Pairings, Players, Bio) still render without errors; pick-player screen still shows 6 World + 6 NZ chips. CLEANUP: both test photos removed — Ally Pally photo_path cleared via self-remove UI (returns null), Wade Mackie photo_path cleared via admin PATCH with photo_path:'' (direct curl). Final /api/players for both now returns photo_path:null.

integration_issues.flow: Admin bios edit sheet → Remove photo (btn-remove-photo)
integration_issues.issue: In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/bios.tsx removePhoto() calls update.mutateAsync({ photo_path: null }). Server appears to drop null fields (likely Pydantic exclude_unset / exclude_none on PATCH), so admin Remove does NOT clear the photo_path. Direct curl PATCH with photo_path:'' (empty string) returns 200 and clears correctly — same pattern that self-remove in bio.tsx uses. Suggestion: change bios.tsx removePhoto to send photo_path:'' instead of null (match bio.tsx). Low priority — pre-existing, not caused by this iteration's cropper changes, and not in scope of this review.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. The <View pointerEvents="none" ... /> inside the cropper triggers the warning. Non-blocking, but recommended to migrate to style={{ pointerEvents: 'none', ... }} to silence.

action_items: (Optional, out of scope) In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/bios.tsx, change admin removePhoto to send photo_path:'' instead of null so admin Remove button clears avatars server-side (matches self-remove pattern).
(Optional) Migrate photo-cropper.tsx circle overlay to use style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: trophy-cabinet.tsx correctly removes the 'Team World/Team NZ' text under each year — now renders only the flag/globe emoji in <Text style={styles.smallTeam}>.

trophy-cabinet.tsx big 2026 trophy still shows '?' when winner is null/undefined and renders 'Tied' for TIE and the full teamLabel when NZ/WORLD — the old 'Decided after the final round' subtitle is removed.

photo-cropper.tsx is well-isolated: useCropper() returns a promise that resolves to the cropped URI (or null on cancel) and a cropperElement to mount — reused by both bio.tsx and bios.tsx without duplication.
photo-cropper.tsx uses expo-image-manipulator to crop + resize to 512x512 JPEG at 0.8 quality — matches the spec. Clamp logic for translate correctly bounds pan to the frame size.
bio.tsx and bios.tsx both correctly await requestCrop() before uploading, and bail out when it returns null (cancel). Correct use of react-query invalidateQueries after upload.
seed_data_creation: No seed changes. Test photos uploaded to Ally Pally and Wade Mackie during tests were both removed. Final state: /api/players photo_path = null for both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin PIN 1926. Menu testIDs: header-menu-button, menu-admin-login, admin-pin-input, admin-pin-submit, menu-admin-bios, menu-logout. Cropper testIDs: cropper-frame, cropper-zoom-in, cropper-zoom-out, cropper-reset, cropper-done, cropper-cancel. On web the ImagePicker uses a file chooser — use `page.expect_file_chooser()` + `fc.set_files(path)`. Bio screen uses /api/photos-self (no auth) with field player_id; admin bios uses /api/photos with Bearer token. Admin PATCH /api/players/{id} drops null fields — send photo_path:'' to clear. trophy-2026-winner text is '?' when cup_winner null, 'Tied' for TIE, or the full teamLabel for NZ/WORLD.
rca_of_issue: Minor pre-existing issue (out of scope): admin bios remove sends photo_path:null which server drops; use empty string. All iteration-4 features (trophy text removal, big-trophy subtitle removal, cropper modal) implemented correctly.
